instrument: xml `calls` ruling — clause 1 of the four-clause bar, every ambiguous edge enumerated

ruling.cause: IN-DOCUMENT NAME COLLISION, and nothing else: every one of the 279 is the analyzer's class `in-document` (261 ambDeclOnly + 18 ambBoth), `twin` 0 and `noDecl` 0 confirm nothing is wrong-file or dangling.
ruling.whyDeterminate: The resolver ranks the edge's OWN FILE ahead of everything else (`resolveTargetStmt` / I13: declaration, same-file, same-language, id), and EVERY ONE of the 279 has a declaration of the callee in its own file — the distribution is exactly 1 in-file declaration for all 279, including all 18 cross-kind edges (whose second kind lives in another file). A collision the own file settles does not reach the tie-break.
ruling.falsifier: an ambiguous `calls` edge with declarationsInOwnFile === 0 would falsify determinacy-by-own-file-preference. MEASURED: 0 of 279. The probe prints the falsifier as a count and lists every counterexample in full (there are none).
ruling.notClaimed: This is a MODEL-level ruling. It does not claim the store binds these edges to the own-file declaration — see the counter-evidence below.

counterEvidenceKeptOpen.store: On libxslt the store probe measured `calls` bound 400/400 with boundSameFile 262 and **boundOtherFile 138 (34.5%)** — cross-file bindings that own-file preference should have prevented, on a type whose callees the analyzer only emits when the document declares them.
counterEvidenceKeptOpen.whyItIsNotResolvedHere: This is the same store-side question as the order-dependence finding (2f2a5bb1f): the eager insert-time resolver decides with whatever the table holds when the batch runs. The determinism probe independently measured `calls` as 17 of the rows that differ between the eager and deferred arms. So the model says determinate and the store demonstrably binds elsewhere on a third of one repository's calls — the store-side split (json-lane's generalization, which the Lead is routing) is what would settle it.
counterEvidenceKeptOpen.falsifierForTheStoreSide: a store probe per calls edge reporting intended / sameFileOffLine / arbitraryTwin / unbound, as json-lane is building for `contains`.
